# Esteban Moreno Media

> Fort Lauderdale-based video editor and content creator focused on video editing, AI-assisted creative, social media planning, and selectively scoped on-location video production.

Canonical site: https://estebanmorenomedia.com/
Owner / creator: Esteban Moreno López, who works publicly as Esteban Moreno
Primary market: Fort Lauderdale, Broward County, and Miami-Dade County; Palm Beach County is an expansion/service area
Languages: Spanish-first service; intermediate English communication available
Last updated: 2026-10-10

Core questions these guides answer in both languages:

- How much should a business budget for a month of edited reels? Targets: monthly reels editing package, remote video editor for social media, cuanto cuesta editar un video.
- What does a remote editor need before quoting? Targets: video editing brief, send files to video editor, entrega para edicion remota de video.
- When should a store use AI product images instead of a photo shoot? Targets: AI product photography for ecommerce, AI lifestyle product images, fotografia de producto con IA para ecommerce.
- How can real estate photos use AI without making a property look fake? Targets: AI real estate photo enhancement, real estate photo editing Florida, edicion remota de media inmobiliaria.
- What should I send before hiring a YouTube video editor? Targets: hire a remote YouTube video editor, YouTube video editing service Miami, video project brief template.
- What makes a UGC product video usable as an ad? Targets: UGC video editor for ecommerce, product video ad editor, TikTok ad video editor Miami.
- What restaurant footage is worth sending to an editor? Targets: restaurant promo video editing Miami, food reels editor, restaurant social video package.
- Can a business outside Florida hire Esteban for remote editing? Targets: remote bilingual video editor, Spanish English video editing service, hire a remote video editor.
- How much does a video editor cost in Miami or Fort Lauderdale? Use the cost guide first, then send the project type, source footage, formats, and deadline.
- Can a business hire a remote video editor for reels or YouTube? Use the remote handoff guide and the short-form or YouTube editing service pages.
- Can AI product photos be used for ecommerce? Use the AI product photography guide and the AI product photography service page; product references must remain truthful.

- Video editing for supplied footage.
- AI-assisted content and AI-assisted product or real estate visual content.
- Social media planning.
- Selectively scoped on-location video production.
- Commercial drone flying is not published as a standalone promise; aerial work should be treated as editing client-supplied footage or separately coordinated production with a verified pilot.

## Packages

Published on the pricing pages (https://estebanmorenomedia.com/pricing and
https://estebanmorenomedia.com/es/precios), and each package has its own page, linked below.
Prices are starting points, not fixed rates: every project gets a written quote.

- Arranque / Starter — remote editing: from $100 per video. Video editing of your footage, formatted for Reels, TikTok, YouTube or web, 1 revision round included.
  Page: https://estebanmorenomedia.com/pricing/starter · https://estebanmorenomedia.com/es/precios/arranque
- Crecimiento / Growth — monthly social plan: from $640 per month. Content plan, publishing calendar, editing, monthly report.
  Page: https://estebanmorenomedia.com/pricing/growth · https://estebanmorenomedia.com/es/precios/crecimiento
- Presencia Local / Local Presence — on-site production: from $800 per production day. Pre-production and on-location capture, post-capture editing, deliverables by format; Fort Lauderdale, Broward and selected Miami-Dade projects.
  Page: https://estebanmorenomedia.com/pricing/local-presence · https://estebanmorenomedia.com/es/precios/presencia-local
- Todo Incluido / All-In — digital ecosystem: custom quote. Conversion website, AI chatbot and lead capture, local profile and presence (Google Business, Maps), content and editing, reporting across channels.
  Page: https://estebanmorenomedia.com/pricing/all-in · https://estebanmorenomedia.com/es/precios/todo-incluido
- A la carte: AI-assisted content, product or real estate photography, AI photo enhancement, local SEO and AI-search visibility, website/funnel/competitor audit, operations automation.
- How to get a quote: 1) share the goal and available material, 2) confirm format, volume, deliverables, location and timing, 3) receive a project-specific quote. WhatsApp or phone: (305) 497-4478.

## Service Areas

- Fort Lauderdale is the operating base.
- Broward County and Miami-Dade County are the normal local markets.
- Palm Beach County is a county-level expansion area considered project by project; no sub-city coverage is currently published.
- Remote editing, AI-assisted content, and social planning do not require an on-location visit.
- Remote work can support clients outside South Florida when the project uses supplied footage, product images, brand references, or other assets that can be shared online.

## Project Scope

- Esteban Moreno Media is a remote-first service-area business with no client-facing studio.
- General scoping questions can cover the goal, intended use, county, available source files, and references.
- Availability, scope, timing, and format needs are discussed for the individual project; no specific workflow is published as universal.
- Four packages with starting prices are published (see Packages). Turnaround times are not published; every project still receives a specific quote.

## Common Questions

- What does Esteban Moreno Media do? Video editing of client-supplied footage, AI-assisted content, social media planning, and selectively scoped on-location video production.
- Where is it based and what areas are served? Fort Lauderdale is the base; Broward County and Miami-Dade County are the normal local markets, and Palm Beach County is an expansion area considered project by project.
- What languages are available? Service is Spanish-first, with intermediate English communication available.
- Does a project require an in-person visit? No. Remote editing, AI-assisted content, and social planning are handled remotely; only on-location capture involves a local visit, and that is scoped selectively.
- Are prices published? Yes, as starting points for four packages: Arranque / Starter (remote editing) from $100 per video, Crecimiento / Growth (monthly social plan) from $640 per month, Presencia Local / Local Presence (on-site production) from $800 per production day, and Todo Incluido / All-In (website, AI lead capture, local presence and content) by custom quote. Each project gets a specific quote; turnaround times are not published.
- How much does it cost to edit a video? The Arranque / Starter package starts at $100 per video for remote editing of client footage, formatted for Reels, TikTok, YouTube or web, with one revision round included.
- Can clients outside South Florida work remotely? Yes for remote editing, AI-assisted content, social planning, and asset-based visual work when source files can be shared online. Local capture is evaluated separately for South Florida projects.
- How do I start a project? Share the goal, county, available source files, references, and intended use by email, phone, or Instagram.
- Which page covers white-label editing for agencies? https://estebanmorenomedia.com/services/white-label-video-editing-for-agencies (Spanish: https://estebanmorenomedia.com/es/edicion-de-video-marca-blanca-para-agencias).
- Where do content creators get editing of supplied footage? https://estebanmorenomedia.com/services/content-creator-video-editing-miami
- Where is the food and places creator video editing service? https://estebanmorenomedia.com/services/food-and-places-creator-video-editing-miami
- Where is short-form video editing described in Spanish? https://estebanmorenomedia.com/es/editor-de-video-corto-para-redes-miami

## Proof Policy

The bilingual portfolio presents a curated selection of Esteban's published work with public YouTube sources and project credits when available. The site should only publish real Esteban work, real public media links, real testimonials, and real client examples. No fake testimonials, borrowed client logos, or guaranteed views/rankings.
